title: One Sentence, Five Slides
hook_vo: Ask an AI in one sentence, and get a five-slide talk in LayerCue.

beats.vo: Open a new chat in your AI app, and ask in plain words.
Minutes later, the whole talk is already in LayerCue.
The AI draws every picture itself, and you can still edit it.
No connection? Copy as HTML, and any AI chat can help.
